summary: All five ACs are implemented and faithful, and nothing was added beyond scope. AC1 StackProfilesCard groups by source, shows resolver error and warnings, states engine-unavailable and unsupported-contract. AC2 create validates name, refuses any existing name, wx write, resolver validation with rollback, route maps 201/400/409/500. AC3 activeQuestions inserts the stack question only with own profiles, drops remember/where, disables invalid, setCustomProfiles ignored past step 1. AC4 contract_version != 1 refused, real-output fixture + contract test. AC5 adoptSnapshotProfile tolerates 1.0, reads 1.1, refuses newer major. Out of scope respected; index.ts does not grow.
